text: Heather was a pleasure to work with! Her skill is A+ rated! She called to talk with me before the wedding so she can get specifics on exactly what I want. We talked for over an hour! She was patient as I started to alter what I wanted and understood the look I was going for. The day of the wedding she was absolutely incredible. She would politely and softly get my wedding Director to get my attention to approve what she was painting and making sure I liked her approach. She was absolutely incredible! I highly suggest her for your commissions, she truly captures the people, style, and personality in her art.

owner_reply.text: Meagan, I am so honored to have worked with you! I looove how your painting turned out! Thank you for trusting me to capture your wedding!!Enjoy!!🌸💗🌸
